name: 05_consumer_finance_edge_model

dataset.display_name: 2022 Survey of Consumer Finances — Summary Extract
dataset.split: quota stratified by target distribution plus high-variance feature quantile bins

business_question: Which program is most accurate while fitting in an on-device model budget? (structural, reproducible)

seeds.source: step-60000 neural policy (Rust/Candle CPU), produced by agy_resource_fitness; see seeds.provenance.json

calibration.rules: limits = median calibration reading (2 s.f.); composite resource scale = median reading, accuracy scale = train target sigma; prices = share x median error / median reading

why: An on-device financial-advice app ships the model inside the app bundle, so the model's serialized size is a hard limit. model_bytes is structural, so this case reproduces bit-for-bit on any host.
caveats: model_bytes is the canonical JSON serialization of the fitted model, a size proxy rather than the exact size of a native artifact.
comparability: TARGET IDENTITY: target is INCOME and the features include its components (WAGEINC, BUSSEFARMINC, INTDIVINC, KGINC, SSRETINC, TRANSFOTHINC); plain ridge R2 = 0.993. Accuracy contests measure linear-identity recovery, not modelling skill
model_bytes is our canonical JSON serialization vs each library's native format
